# Il Colosseo

> > Comprehensive guide to visiting the Colosseum, Roman Forum, Palatine Hill, Vatican Museums, and other major Rome attractions with ticket booking and tourist information.

Il Colosseo is a tourism resource dedicated to Rome's ancient monuments and cultural sites, offering historical information, virtual tours, ticket reservations, and guided tour options. The site provides multilingual content covering the Colosseum (Flavian Amphitheater), Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel, and other essential Roman landmarks for visitors planning their trip to the Eternal City.

## Key Topics

- Colosseum (Colosseo/Kolosseum)
- Roman Forum (Foro Romano/Forum Romanum)
- Palatine Hill (Palatino/Palatin)
- Vatican Museums (Musei Vaticani)
- Sistine Chapel (Cappella Sistina)
- Skip-the-line tickets
- Guided tours (Visite guidate)
- Ancient Rome monuments
- Pantheon
- Piazza Navona
- St. Peter's Basilica (Petersdom)
- Rome tourism and attractions
- Ticket booking and reservations
- Tourist information for Rome

## Tickets & Reservations

- [Prenotazione biglietti - Il Colosseo](http://www.il-colosseo.it/prenotazioni.php): Book tickets for Colosseum, Forum, Palatine, Vatican with skip-the-line
- [Ticketbuchung - Das Colosseum](http://www.il-colosseo.it/de/prenotazioni.php): Ticket booking for Colosseum, Forum, Palatine, and Vatican Museums

## The Colosseum - History & Information

- [Tutto sul Colosseo, info, storia e curiosità - Il Colosseo](http://www.il-colosseo.it/colosseo.php): Complete Colosseum history from Nero to Vespasian and Flavian dynasty
- [All about the Colosseum: information, history, and curiosities - The Colosseum](http://www.il-colosseo.it/en/colosseo.php): Colosseum history and facts: Flavian Amphitheater from Nero to Vespasian
- [Il Colosseo](http://www.il-colosseo.it/immagini.php): Main Colosseum page with info on Rome monuments and Vatican Museums

## Guided Tours & Virtual Experiences

- [Guided tours - The Colosseum](http://www.il-colosseo.it/en/visite-guidate.php): Guided tours of Colosseum, Forum, Palatine with arena and underground access
- [Visita virtuale della Cappella Sistina - Il Colosseo](http://www.il-colosseo.it/visita_virtuale_cappella_sistina.php): Virtual tour of Sistine Chapel with Vatican Museums and Rome attractions

## Visitor Information & Planning

- [Informazioni turistiche - Il Colosseo](http://www.il-colosseo.it/informazioni-turistiche.php): Tourist info for Rome's Civic Museums, hours, tickets, and free entry
- [Calendar 2025 - The Colosseum](http://www.il-colosseo.it/en/calendario.php): 2025 calendar with Colosseum event schedule and visitor information

## Events & Cultural Activities

- [Frühlings- und Osterveranstaltungen in Rom - Das Kolosseum](http://www.il-colosseo.it/de/pasqua-pasquetta-roma.php): Easter and spring events in Rome: Via Crucis, marathon, opening hours
- [Ereignis und zeigt in Rom - Das Kolosseum](http://www.il-colosseo.it/de/eventi.php): Rome events: Julius Caesar reenactment at Area Sacra and cultural shows
- [Come visitare Roma in modo originale – The Colosseum Blog](http://www.il-colosseo.it/blog/index.php/come-visitare-roma-in-modo-originale): Original Rome tours: luxury limousine and night tours of Colosseum, Vatican
- [Roma, aneddoti e curiosita - Il Colosseo](http://www.il-colosseo.it/roma.php): Rome anecdotes featuring Gioacchino Belli, Trilussa, and local traditions
